timeline.author: Luigi Dell'Aquila

timeline.body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/103058

The test was generating wrong data (date strings without milliseconds, that did not match the date pattern)
super nit: probably doesn't affect much, but this could be a pre-compiled pattern to shave some ms off during test execution :D

LGTM.

Long-term, we may want to allow datetimes without millis, but that's beyond the scope of this PR.
